# ccm server baseline

This is the existing server's Claude Code Model Switcher, version 2.3.0
(author credited as Peng in `ccm.sh`), together with its English and Chinese
translation files. The script logic is preserved from the working installation; trailing whitespace is normalized.

The portable launchers live in `scripts/bin/`; Zsh integration lives in
`configs/server/ccm.zsh`. Runtime credentials and saved accounts belong in the
user's HOME. They are not part of this directory or the Git repository.
